title: 13 Squid Nordic Caramel Fudge 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Nordic from 13 Squid is a deliciously decadent dessert flavour that’s rich in sweet and comforting gooey golden caramel and mouth-watering fudge flavour. Unctuous and luxurious, this irresistible flavour from 13 Squid is a must-try for any dessert lover. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your e juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks , producing rich clouds and immaculate flavour.
